p2_b0.ocr: The physician should only physically examine the man if his semen analysis is irregular, classified as LOE C, according to the medical-technical recommendations for general infertility for physicians, specifically for family physician (physical examination).

p2_b1.ocr: The gynecologist should not test ovarian reserve capacity to predict probability of pregnancy (with or without treatment), classified as LOE A, as outlined in the recommendations for unexplained infertility. Additionally, the physician should order a semen analysis from an accredited laboratory (ISO15189) or from a referral hospital, categorized as LOE D, under the organizational recommendations for the organization of fertility care.

Medical-technical recommendations Origin or guideline Chapter of the MuG
The physician should only physically examine the man if his semen analysis is irregular. LOE C General infertility for physicians Family physician (physical examination)
The gynecologist should not test ovarian reserve capacity to predict probability of pregnancy (with or without treatment). LOE A Unexplained infertility Gynecologist (assessments)
Organizational recommendations
The physician should order a semen analysis from an accredited laboratory (ISO15189) or from a referral hospital. LOE D MuG Organization of fertility care
In accordance with the Dutch IVF planning decree, every licensed IVF center and their corresponding transport and satellite centers must provide annual reports on treatment outcomes for uniform national IVF registration. LOE D MuG Organization of fertility care (registration)
Patient-centered recommendations
Both partners of the couple should be involved in the assessment and management of infertility because it is a joint problem. LOE C MuG Physician, gynecologist, and urologist (basic principles)
The gynecologist should offer couples with fertility problems psychological support throughout all phases of fertility care. LOE D MuG Gynecologist (information provision)
Patient recommendations
Patients want their gynecologist to inform them about the different phases of treatment and their expected time spans. LOE P MuG Gynecologist (information provision)
Patients want their physician to make a referral immediately after they have been trying to conceive for 1 year. LOE P MuG physician (referral)

p2_b3.ocr: In accordance with the Dutch IVF planning decree, every licensed IVF center and their corresponding transport and satellite centers must provide annual reports on treatment outcomes for uniform national IVF registration, also classified as LOE D. Patient-centered recommendations emphasize that both partners of the couple should be involved in the assessment and management of infertility because it is a joint problem, noted as LOE C, and the gynecologist should offer couples with fertility problems psychological support throughout all phases of fertility care, categorized as LOE D.

p2_b4.ocr: Regarding patient recommendations, patients want their gynecologist to inform them about the different phases of treatment and their expected time spans, indicated as LOE P, and they want their physician to make a referral immediately after they have been trying to conceive for 1 year, also classified as LOE P. The gynecologist's role in information provision is underscored in each of these recommendations, demonstrating the importance of comprehensive care in fertility management.
